cues.zh: 選取全部、複製，再回到邏輯斯迴歸檔案貼上。

cues.en: So command and control us enter to execute.

cues.en: Here we go the data set is well imported.
cues.zh: 資料集已匯入。

cues.en: Let's click on that.
cues.zh: 點它。

cues.en: And here is the data set.
cues.zh: 這就是資料。

cues.en: So as a quick reminder this dataset contains informations of users of a social network.
cues.zh: 提醒，資料包含社群網路使用者的資訊。

cues.en: These informations are to user id the gender the age and the estimated salary and the social network
cues.zh: 包括 User ID、性別、年齡與估計薪資；社群網路

cues.en: has several business clients and its business clients put ads on the social network for marketing campaigns
cues.zh: 有多個企業客戶，會刊登廣告進行行銷，

cues.en: purposes and one of their business clients is a car company who has just launched its brand new luxury SUV at a ridiculous price.
cues.zh: 其中一家車商剛推出價格驚人的豪華 SUV。

cues.en: So this car company put ads of their SUV product on the social network.
cues.zh: 車商在社群媒體刊登 SUV 廣告。

cues.en: And then the social network gathered some informations about which users responded positively to the
cues.zh: 社群網路再蒐集哪些使用者正面回應，

cues.en: ads and by buying the product and those who responded negatively by not buying the product.
cues.zh: 購買產品，以及哪些人負面回應，沒有購買。

cues.en: So that's what the last column is about.
cues.zh: 這就是最後一欄的意義。

cues.en: The last column tells for each user if the user bought the car and then it's a one or didn't buy the car and then it's zero.
cues.zh: 每位使用者買車為 1，沒買為 0。

cues.en: All right so that's the business problem itself.
cues.zh: 這就是商業問題。

cues.en: And now our mission is to make logistic regression model that will try to understand the correlations
cues.zh: 我們的任務是建立邏輯斯迴歸，了解

cues.en: between information such as the age and the salary and the decision of the user to buy yes or no the SUV.
cues.zh: 年齡、薪資等資訊，與是否購買 SUV 之間的關聯。

cues.en: All right so let's go back to our logistic regression model and let's see what we need to change next .
cues.zh: 回到模型，看看下一步改什麼。

cues.en: So this line is to select the variables who want to train our model with.
cues.zh: 這行選取要用於訓練的變數。

cues.en: So as I just said we're going to train our model with only the age and the salary.
cues.zh: 如剛所說，只使用年齡與薪資。

cues.en: So that means that we want to predict that the user is going to buy the SUV based on only the age and the salary.
cues.zh: 也就是只根據年齡和薪資，預測是否買 SUV。

cues.en: So here will need to select the indexes of the columns we want to take for our model.
cues.zh: 這裡選取要納入模型的欄位索引。

cues.en: So I'm going to remove that as comment and let's look at the indexes.
cues.zh: 先取消註解，再看索引。

cues.en: OK so indexes in our data one that's one two three four and five.
cues.zh: R 的索引從 1 開始，依序 1、2、3、4、5。

cues.en: So we only want to take the indexes 3 4 and 5.
So let's do this.
cues.zh: 現在來做。

cues.en: We're going to choose from three to five.
cues.zh: 選 3 到 5。

cues.en: All right so now let's select this and execute.
cues.zh: 選取並執行。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now if we go back to our data sets you can see that we only have our three columns of interest which are the age the salary and purchased.
cues.zh: 回到資料集，只剩關心的三欄：年齡、薪資、Purchased。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now next step next step is to split the data sets into the training set and the test sets and here what we only need to change is the split ratio or maybe not.
cues.zh: 下一步分成訓練集與測試集，只可能需要改 split_ratio，也可以不改。

cues.en: But we have 400 observations I think a good split would be to have 300 observations in the training set and 100 observations in the test set.
cues.zh: 共有 400 筆，訓練 300 筆、測試 100 筆很合適。

cues.en: And to do this we need to take 0.75.
cues.zh: 所以使用 0.75。

cues.en: That is 75 percent go into the training set.
cues.zh: 75% 進入訓練集。

cues.en: That is 300 observations.
cues.zh: 也就是 300 筆觀測。

cues.en: Okay so let's look like this and come in or control us enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取，按 Command 或 Control+Enter 執行。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Now let's look at our training set and our test set.
cues.zh: 看訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: All right so our training centers you can see has 300 observations and the test said has 100 observations listed here.
cues.zh: 訓練集 300 筆，測試集這裡列出 100 筆。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now let's go back to a logistic regression and take care of the next step which is the feature scaling .
cues.zh: 回到模型，處理下一步特徵縮放。

cues.en: So for classification it's better to do feature skating.
cues.zh: 分類時，做特徵縮放比較好。

cues.en: So we're going to do it we're going to remove those guns here by pressing command or control plus shift plus seat.
cues.zh: 取消註解，按 Command 或 Control+Shift+C。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now let's check that we have the right indexes here we have indexes two and three here.
cues.zh: 現在檢查索引，這裡原本是 2 與 3。

cues.en: The dependent variable is categorical.
cues.zh: 應變數是類別型。

cues.en: So we will only scale this and that's index 1 and 2.
cues.zh: 所以只縮放前兩欄，索引 1 和 2。

cues.en: So let's go back to our logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 回到模型。

cues.en: And so here we need to choose one to two let's do it for the 4 to 1 2 and 1 2.
cues.zh: 將這裡選為 1:2，相關位置也都改為 1:2。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Select this in a control and so execute.
cues.zh: 選取並按 Control+Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Now let's have a look at our training sets.
cues.zh: 現在看訓練集。

cues.en: The age and the salary are perfectly scaled and the same for the test sets.
cues.zh: 年齡和薪資都已正確縮放，測試集也相同。

cues.en: Perfect perfect scale.
cues.zh: 很好，尺度正確。

cues.zh: 資料前處理完成。
